claims.text: The authors compare MERF against existing application-specific techniques, including CPSL, SystemT, and TEXTMARKER.
CPSL is a common pattern specification language that MERF extends with additional features.
SystemT aims to overcome limitations of CPSL and uses an algebraic approach for information extraction.
TEXTMARKER is a semi-automatic rule-based information extraction system that provides a GUI editor.
